final_lessons: For this regression dataset, much wider MLPs can beat narrower or layer-normalized alternatives under SGD.
Width 256 without layer norm is consistently strong here, even with only two layers.
Repeated candidate c_c1617c is a reliable winner against narrower or layer-normalized MLPs in this setting.
The simple 2-layer width-256 ReLU MLP can beat deeper width-256 variants when layer norm is present.
Very narrow deep MLPs, especially width 16 with several layer norms, perform poorly on this regression task.
Repeated candidate c_bec5a1 is the strongest observed choice so far with test MSE around 0.345.
Residual width-64 can be decent, but c_bec5a1 remains much better than residual or layer-normalized challengers.
When clean width-256 models are absent, residual width-128 can be the best fallback despite multiple layer norms.
Shallow width-128 and residual width-128 are mid-tier, while c_bec5a1 remains clearly superior.
Between width-256 models, removing layer norm is more important than adding depth for this SGD regression setting.
